verdict_reason: Species-card assertions correctly match the frontend's 'code — Latin name' title and take the common name from reference-data, but the spec body gains an if/throw conditional and keeps a rationale comment about a locator.

todos.issue: Lines 53-55 put an if/throw guard in the spec body to check that reference-data gives the cattle line a common name; the Playwright guide bans conditionals in a spec ('Keep specs flat').
todos.fix: Must: the spec body has no conditional; a missing common name still fails the test with a clear message. One way: move the non-null check into the reference-data client (for example a findCommonName(line) that throws when the species has none), or replace the if with expect(commonName, '...').toBeTruthy().

todos.issue: The comment on lines 13-14 ('The commodity-total labels are h3s too, so the section headings are read off their own class...') describes other parts of the UI and gives the rationale for a locator choice; house rules put rationale in docs, and a comment describes only its own lines.
todos.fix: Must: no comment explains the locator choice; the locator says what it selects by itself. One way: delete the comment, and if the heading list needs scoping, scope it to the task-list region or a named page-object accessor (for example overview.sectionHeadings) instead of the class.
